Callout.Name: Taxi Rank Dispute
Callout.Message: Taxis blocking a rank and arguing with each other.
Callout.Advisory: Three vehicles, drivers out, no violence.

Script.Line: I have been on this rank nine years. This is my spot.
He is the one who pulled in on top of me.
I am not moving until somebody tells me who was first.

Lines.Approach: Three of them out of their cars shouting at each other over a fare.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
